completed_missions.title: Build persistent 11-agent Hixton swarm
completed_missions.result: Eleven role contracts, persistent knowledge, regression protocol and GitHub-hosted cloud orchestration were established. Legacy laptop-bound engineering launchers and local agent runners were removed.

completed_missions.title: Complete USDT to USDC migration audit, explain backtest delta, repair defects, retest
completed_missions.result: The complete A01-A11 chain passed after repairs. No supported USDT-to-USDC strategy/code defect explains the historic 733-versus-about-203 difference. The dominant difference is the non-equivalent account path: the old USDT reference carried prior equity/positions into the later period, while the later USDT/USDC controls restarted fresh. On the same fresh-start window USDC slightly outperformed USDT. Persistent portfolio drawdown/risk halting explains most rejected entries on the fresh path. Paper/shared-portfolio parity matched exactly under equivalent assumptions.

active_mission.title: Continuous closed-loop Paper bot engineering guard
active_mission.objective: Continuously keep the Hixton Paper-only system internally consistent as new features, fixes and experiments are added. Every material extension must be checked by all eleven role layers, must preserve the USDC migration invariants, must detect stale lifecycle/runtime/evidence state, must route any proven defect back to its owning layer, and must not reach QA/governance completion while required evidence is missing. Operational validation uses real public Binance USDC market data with simulated fills and persistent Paper account state only.
active_mission.last_transition_reason: SWARM-002 completed with full A01-A11 QA/governance evidence; continuous regression and lifecycle monitoring now owns subsequent extensions.
constraints: Run in GitHub-hosted virtual environments; no owner laptop dependency.
The eleven cloud roles must run without OpenAI/API secrets; their default mode is deterministic verification and supervision.
Trading mode is permanently Paper-only for this project phase: real public Binance market data, simulated orders/fills, persistent Paper account state.
Never send real or testnet exchange orders and never request Binance account credentials.
Do not replace real Binance candles with synthetic market data for operational Paper evaluation; deterministic fixtures remain allowed only for unit/regression tests.
Every material extension must emit role-specific evidence rather than only a PASS flag.
A10 must reject missing/stale specialist evidence, incomplete regression coverage, or an active mission left at NEW after work has started, and route the defect into repair.
A11 must independently verify the evidence contract, A10 repair state and A09 QA gate before GOVERNANCE_PASS.

A known-safe lifecycle defect where an active mission is still NEW may be normalized automatically to IN_PROGRESS before specialist execution; no other autonomous repository mutation is implied by that repair.
Audit every active-bot occurrence of legacy USDT market symbols; historical evidence and explicit legacy-rejection guards may remain but must never become active runtime configuration.
Keep the historic USDT and fresh-start USDT/USDC references distinct; never compare a carried account path to a fresh start as if they were equivalent.
Do not weaken the 5 percent daily loss pause or 20 percent drawdown halt merely to improve historical performance.
Do not activate new strategy or risk parameters without a separate explicit owner activation decision.
Repair only proven implementation/configuration/data/reporting defects; do not tune the strategy merely to force a historical target.
Keep failed candidates, losing windows and contradictory evidence visible.
After any repair, rerun all eleven roles before completion is claimed.
acceptance: All eleven roles participate in every material guard run and emit fresh role-specific evidence for their assigned layer.
All eleven default cloud roles execute without OpenAI or Binance private API credentials.
A01 validates mission state, requirements and Paper-only invariants before specialist evidence can be accepted.
A02 continuously preserves the controlled same-window USDT/USDC and carried-versus-fresh diagnosis evidence.
A03 continuously verifies Paper/shared-portfolio parity and persistent Paper state under equivalent assumptions.
A04 continuously verifies active UI/report quote provenance and reproducible shipped UI assets.
A05 continuously verifies Paper ledger integrity and freshness and fails on stale state.
A06 executes the full integration/regression suite after changes and exposes failures rather than masking them.
A07 verifies all ten real public Binance USDC markets and current public candle access without private credentials.
A08 verifies strategy/risk invariants and the documented early-loss/risk-halt path without weakening risk controls.
A09 performs fresh full Python and UI QA and issues QA_PASS only after A01-A08 and A10 are clean.
A10 verifies the mission-specific evidence matrix, detects lifecycle/evidence drift, and reports repair_required=false only when every required specialist category is actually covered.
A11 independently rechecks the mission-specific evidence matrix, QA_PASS, A10 repair state and Paper-only contract before GOVERNANCE_PASS.
An active mission cannot silently remain NEW once specialist work begins; the lifecycle guard either repairs the known-safe NEW-to-IN_PROGRESS transition or the run fails closed.

The original 3x80 USDT reference remains reproducible at approximately 733.306 ending equity from the documented 2023-09-01 start, while the later fresh controls remain separately attributed at approximately 201.11 USDT and approximately 203.62 USDC from 2024-03-24.
The 733-versus-about-203 explanation remains attributed to account-path/start-state differences plus the dominant early persistent portfolio-risk halt, not to the quote migration without evidence.
No automatic merge, no real-money order path and no active-strategy activation occurs.
